# ghost/flashcards-vocab

FlashCards (F-Droid): built-in vocabulary quizzes (emoji, English, German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese). Start a quiz, read each question, answer it and read the score. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/flashcards-vocab
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards-vocab open_decks --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards-vocab start_quiz --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards-vocab get_question --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards-vocab answer --device <serial> --param option=<option>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards-vocab answer_many --device <serial> --param options=<options>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards-vocab get_results --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_decks`: Open the FlashCards folders
- `start_quiz`: Start a 3 question emoji quiz in FlashCards
- `get_question`: What is the current FlashCards question?
- `answer`: Answer option 2 in the FlashCards quiz
- `answer_many`: Answer the next FlashCards questions with options 1 and 2
- `get_results`: What was my FlashCards quiz score?
